## What you will build

1. Set up PyTorch Geometric and turn a network into a Data object with node features.
2. Implement GCN, GAT and GraphSAGE and train them for node classification.
3. Compare their accuracy on the same train/validation split.
4. Build a link prediction model on top of the learned representations.
5. Assemble a graph classification model with a readout layer.
6. Visualize the learned node embeddings, and the attention weights for GAT.

## What to watch for

- Train GCNs with 2, 4, 8 and 16 layers. Accuracy will peak early and then fall — plot it, because over-smoothing is much more convincing when you have caused it yourself.
- Replace the node features with all-ones and re-run. Whatever accuracy remains came from topology alone.
